profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Ridgeline
profile.summary: Hi I'm Ellese! A UC Berkeley alum with a BA in Applied Mathematics. I enjoy solving complex problems, building thoughtful technology, and contributing to work that has a meaningful impact. Outside of work, you’ll usually find me exploring in the mountains, playing music, or solving crosswords!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Los Gatos, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Specialized in building and scaling cloud-based communication systems using AWS, SQL/NoSQL databases, and internal microservices
- Architected and documented microservice design patterns in collaboration with cross-functional teams
- Implemented rate limiting and throttling strategies to improve system reliability and performance under high load
- Improved customer visibility into leak detection and alerting, enhancing user trust and engagement
- Increased customer transparency to leak detection and alerts! We love saving water!
- Contributed to PostgreSQL optimization efforts for time-series data, researching partitioning strategies, indexing techniques, and storage models to support high-volume, time-based workloads
- Evaluated database design tradeoffs to improve query performance, scalability, and data retention strategies

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.locationName: Los Gatos, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a two-way in-app communication system using AWS Pinpoint and Elasticsearch to improve transparency between customers and utilities regarding leak management, infrastructure maintenance, and billing issues.
- Led the modernization of notification infrastructure, transitioning from outdated Firebase and SMS systems to using AWS Pinpoint which lead to streamlined deliver, improved metrics, and reducing operational overhead.
- Implemented push notifications across multiple locations of the BEACON application to improve transparency between users and their water consumption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Gatos, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented multiple AWS lambda functions that rely on technologies including S3, SQS, Pinpoint, SecretsManager, DynamoDB, Route53, Elasticsearch, MySQL
- Worked closely with California state water utilities to collaborate and discuss how to develop applications in an effective and easy-to-use way

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
SlingFin is a leader in producing high-alpine tents for the backcountry. Tents are created with durability and quality as the top priorities, using only the best materials and innovation in tent design.

During my time there I:
- Helped run a KickStarter campaign for the HoneyBadger Pack. Responsibilities included: design feedback and improvements, marketing and social media promotion, and assembly and production of the pack. The campaign raised over $30,000 and sold over 200 packs.
- Assisted with technical writing and document proofing of databases, the website, and user manuals.

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description:
Everyone Counts specializes in election modernization and re-inventing the way we think of voting. Their mission is to ensure that in every democracy people have the right to vote, and can easily do so privately, independently, and securely. 

I specifically worked on projects for the 2016 Presidential Elections and my responsibilities included:
- Software integrity testing 
- User experience testing 
- Technical and User manuals edits/reviews

volunteerExperiences.description:
CHAOS is UC Berkeley's oldest and largest official club. It is an interest-based organization that revolves around hiking and outdoor sports.

Responsibilities: 
- Created a digital solution to increase efficiency of member sign-ups that allows for insight into member statistics such as age, outdoor experience, and interests in order to allow for CHAOS to better cater to our members
- Led a team of officers to increase accessibility to the outdoors for over 1000 club members through guided club excursions, running a free gear-rental program, and organizing workshops and courses on outdoor topics
- Created the official website (chaosberkeley.org)
- Planned and hosted the very first CHAOS Welcome Week which gathered over 400 people in attendance

Expanding Your Horizons is a non-profit annual event held on UC Berkeley's campus to promote young girls from the Bay Area to pursue their education in STEM fields. 

Responsibilities:
- Coordinated and ran a workshop that taught girls basic mechanics and physics, and facilitated a discussion about why I chose STEM.

projects.title: Bring Back the Sun
projects.description: I solved a binary classification problem to categorize photos as “sunny” or “cloudy” using a multi-layer perceptron and k-fold cross validation to train on features extracted using AlexNet and compared average accuracy over test data to choose the best algorithm.

projects.title: Railway Network
projects.description: I fully implemented a graph using an adjacency list structure to mirror the structure of a railway network. I also fully implemented breadth-first search and traverse algorithms in order to provide useful functionality as returning the shortest path between two stations and compared the efficiency of the algorithms to expected run-times in order to find the best implementation.

organizations.name: UC Berkeley Symphony Orchestra
organizations.description: Oboist in UC Berkeley's premier orchestra, which holds monthly concerts for the public.

organizations.name: Cal Hiking and Outdoors Society
organizations.description:
Leader and Head Organizer of...
- John Muir Trail 2018 (6 person team)
- Mount Whitney 2017 (15 person team)
- Mount Shasta 2017 (6 person team)

Ambassador (May 2018 - Present): With over 900 club members, communication between the member body and the officers can get muddled and confused. My role is to facilitate clear and active communication between the members and the board of CHAOS.

Treasurer (May 2017 - May 2018): I started a scholarship fund to encourage more student-led adventures, and modernized the payment methods of CHAOS which also allowed for data about our members to be collected (demographics, age range, interests, etc.).
